VI.description: Open a VI by path and report its modification state. Reads the VI, block diagram and front panel modification bitsets and the User Changes flag over VI Server, then releases the reference. Used to test whether a VI that was patched on disk still loads clean.

Node.inputs: application reference (local):,vi path:20.path,options:,error in (no error):,type specifier VI Refnum (for type only):,password (""):

Node.fields: read+Modifications\3AVI Modifications Bitset,read+Modifications\3ABlock Diagram Mods Bitset,read+Modifications\3AFront Panel Mods Bitset,read+Modifications\3AUser Changes
Node.outputs: Modifications\3AVI Modifications Bitset:40.vi,Modifications\3ABlock Diagram Mods Bitset:40.bd,Modifications\3AFront Panel Mods Bitset:40.fp,Modifications\3AUser Changes:40.uc,reference out:40.ref,error out:40.err
